reason: My guests are tourists who already find me on Google and Tripadvisor, and I don't need another place where one tired traveller can rate my khachapuri badly for everyone to see. Even free for three months, I'm not putting a QR code on my tables that invites dish-by-dish ratings.
objection: Verified reviews could hurt me - one bad dish rating is public forever, and I can't answer or remove it. Plus tourists who visit once won't care about loyalty rewards, and the payment fee on top eats into my thin margin.
would_change_my_mind: If the dish ratings stayed private to me as feedback, and only good ones could be pushed to Google or Tripadvisor at my choice.
